Subject: Renewal invoice & PO info for Redwood renewal (DL-78342)

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — we’re ready to finalize the renewal for our Dedicated pool (DL-78342). A couple of billing items to align on before procurement issues the PO:

- New PO number: 98765 (will be attached)
- Brightleaf requests Net-60 terms for this renewal; is Redwood able to accommodate?
- Billing contact for remit: Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@brightleaf.health> (please send invoices to this address)
- We also need Redwood’s W9 and the completed vendor form (attach if possible)
- We are EU-facing for some business lines; attaching our VAT cert in case you need it for tax handling.

If you can send an invoice that references PO 98765 and Net-60, procurement will sign and return via DocuSign today. We’d like the increased Dedicated capacity to start on 2026-07-01.

Thanks,
Ellen Morris
Senior Procurement Manager
Brightleaf Health

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the PO. Quick answers:

- We can reference PO 98765 on the invoice. Please confirm the exact legal entity name for billing (Brightleaf Health, Inc. vs Brightleaf Health EU Ltd) so the invoice includes the correct remit name.
- Net-60 is not our standard for renewals, but we can make an exception for this account pending FP&A sign-off. I’ve looped in Neha (AE) and Rafael (CS/finance ops) to expedite.
- I’ve attached a provisional invoice (PDF stub) that references the PO; final invoice will be issued after Net-60 approval.
- Our W9 and vendor form are available — I’ll route them to procurement in a separate email.
- We’ll honor your 2026-07-01 start date for the added capacity once the signed DocuSign is returned and PO processed.

Action items I’ll own: confirm legal entity (Ellen), get internal sign-off for Net-60 (Neha/Rafael), send final signed invoice and W9 (me).

Quick question for accounting: Rafael, is there anything else you’ll need to process a Net-60 exception quickly?

Best,
Olga
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Provisional_Invoice_DL-78342.pdf (pdf stub)

Looping in Finance (Rafael) — I spoke with Ellen briefly; Brightleaf is expanding the Dedicated pool by +2 GPUs and adding the advanced telemetry add-on. That incremental ARR is material and we want to keep momentum.

Rafael — can we approve Net-60 for this renewal conditioned on: 1) signed PO 98765, 2) completed vendor form, 3) AP email on the PO (accounts-payable@brightleaf.health)? If so, Olga can issue the final invoice and we get DocuSign back today.

If you prefer, we can do a one-time credit hold and require payment within Net-30 for the incremental portion only — but I’d rather avoid extra friction.

Thanks,
Neha
Account Executive

Confirmed — Finance will approve Net-60 for Brightleaf for this renewal with the following conditions met:
1) We receive an executed PO (Brightleaf_PO_98765.pdf) and DocuSign return
2) Vendor form completed and W9 on file (Olga to send)
3) AP contact listed on the invoice (accounts-payable@brightleaf.health)
4) Redwood retains standard credit control: incremental capacity goes live after PO processing; if payment is delayed past Net-60 we reserve right to suspend non-critical telemetry features (standard clause).

Olga — please issue the final invoice referencing PO 98765 and Net-60 terms; upload the W9 to the vendor portal and CC AP on the invoice email. I’ll mark the deal record for expedited processing. Monica: please prepare the DocuSign envelope (deal DL-78342) so procurement has a quick path to sign.

-Rafael
